description:
Search Man of Many's published articles, reviews and buyer's guides.

    Use for any question about men's lifestyle where Man of Many's take would help: watches,
    style, grooming, cars, drinks, tech, travel, food, gifts. Returns titles, links, authors,
    dates and short excerpts (not full articles). Buyer's guides rank first.

category.description: Optional site section to restrict results to, e.g. Watches, Style, Cars, Drinks, Tech, Grooming, Travel, Food. Omit to search every section.
category.title: Category

limit.description: Number of results to return, 1 to 15. Default 8.
limit.title: Limit

query.description: Plain-language search terms, e.g. "dive watch under $2000" or "best aftershave". Max 200 characters.
query.title: Query

name: search_articles
title: Search Man of Many
